items.summary: 原创 Datawhale 2026-05-04 22:01 浙江 Datawhale干货 开源项目：DeepSeek-TUI 「鲸鱼兄弟们好」 这个五一假期，一个美国独立开发者发了张图，用中文写了一句： 鲸鱼兄弟们，谢谢你们。 「鲸鱼兄弟」是 DeepSeek 粉丝的自称。他用这个词，感谢了一群把他的开源项目推上 GitHub 热榜的中国开发者，现在已经星标 2.7k+ 。 他叫 Hunter Bown ，一个美国人，不是 DeepSeek 团队的人。 但他写的项目，叫 DeepSeek-TUI 。 就是 DeepSeek 版的 Claude Code ：一个用 Rust 写的、住在终端里的编程 Agent，背后跑的是 DeepSeek V4。 国内开发者过去一年对 Claude Code 的心情，大概可以用一个词概括： 眼馋 。 现在有个老外，用 DeepSeek 做了一个同款——开源，免费。 更让人意外的是这些细节。 打开 release 页面，发布包 托管在阿里云 OSS 和腾讯云 COS 上 ——GitHub Release 在国内下载有多慢，开发者都懂。Hunter 不在中国，但他研究过这件事。 他还用 De...
items.summaryZh: Datawhale 介绍了开源项目 DeepSeek-TUI：一个用 Rust 编写、运行在终端里的编程 Agent，体验上类似 Claude Code，但后端使用 DeepSeek V4。项目作者 Hunter Bown 并非 DeepSeek 团队成员，却针对中文开发者体验做了不少细节优化，例如将 release 包托管到阿里云 OSS 和腾讯云 COS，缓解国内下载 GitHub Release 慢的问题。项目已被中国开发者推上 GitHub 热榜并获得数千星标，说明 DeepSeek 生态正在催生面向开发者工具链的开源替代方案。
items.whyItMatters: 这是 DeepSeek 生态在 AI 编程工具方向的开源信号，适合放在开源项目观察。

items.summary: Qdrant 1.18 is out, featuring TurboQuant; a new quantization method developed by Google Research. Our TurboQuant implementation is an extended version of the algorithm with borrowed RaBitQ ideas. It offers: 1. Similar recall to Scalar Quantization (SQ), using 2x less memory. 2. Better recall than Binary Quantization (BQ), using a similar storage budget. items.summary: Most agentic stacks run into the same problems pretty quickly: reasoning and tool parsing drift across turns, KV cache reuse falls apart, or tools fire too late. We’ve been hardening Dynamo’s harness-facing path so @Claudeai Code, @OpenClaw , and @openai Codex-style agent patterns behave reliably on custom stacks and inference endpoints: • Stable prompts for KV reuse and lower TTFT • Interleaved reasoning + tool calls preserved across turns • Streaming tool dispatch instead of end-of-turn buffering • Harness behavior aligned with real multi-turn agent runtimes If you’re building your own agent stack or serving endpoint, this blog goes through the infrastructure issues that tend to show up in practice and the patterns we’ve been using to fix them. items.summary: Great collab with @SakanaAILabs on an #ICML26 paper about sparse transformer kernels + formats optimized for modern NVIDIA GPU execution. • TwELL sparse packing • Fused CUDA kernels • 20%+ inference/training speedups at scale Paper + code below 👇 hardmaru @hardmaru The human brain🧠 is incredibly efficient because it only activates the specific neurons needed for a thought. Modern LLMs naturally try to do this too (> 95% of neurons in feedforward layers stay silent for any given word), but our hardware punishes them for it. One of the most frustrating paradoxes in deep learning: making a model do less math often makes it run slower. Why? Because unstructured sparsity introduces irregular memory access, and GPUs are built for predictable, dense blocks of math. We teamed up with @NVIDIA to try to fix this hardware mismatch. Instead of forcing the GPU to adapt to the sparsity, we built...
